tutorials.name: Introduction
tutorials.problem:
We categorize angles that are not right, straight, or full into three groups.

- An **acute angle** has a measure between $0^\circ$ and $90^\circ\mathbin{:}$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14132438/assets/ec35031af65d0ea9e08121d3df02ed136c5b81b2f90698f4a51681657e67de48.png)

- An **obtuse angle** has a measure between $90^\circ$ and  $180^\circ\mathbin{:}$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14132438/assets/a96bdfed918f56e7f5cc1cfe9eaad42dcd32a54e663c78fead08e68e6ef80865.png)

- Angles whose measure is between $180^\circ$ and $360^\circ$ are called **reflex angles**.  

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14132438/assets/62323a85f8b3357628c2d221f0293c94ec4c3d9e6e8d1ca65400d2ea7349d3ce.png)

- An **obtuse angle** has a measure between $90^\circ$ and  $180^\circ\mathbin{:}$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14132438/assets/a96bdfed918f56e7f5cc1cfe9eaad42dcd32a54e663c78fead08e68e6ef80865.png)

- Angles whose measure is between $180^\circ$ and $360^\circ$ are called **reflex angles**.  

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14132438/assets/62323a85f8b3357628c2d221f0293c94ec4c3d9e6e8d1ca65400d2ea7349d3ce.png)
